description: This PHP class defines an AWS SDK client for interacting with the AmazonConnectCampaignServiceV2. It includes method signatures for various campaign management operations, such as creating, deleting, describing, and updating campaigns, as well as managing connect instances and resources.

classes.name: ConnectCampaignsV2Client
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AmazonConnectCampaignsV2 service in AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: createCampaign
methods.description: Creates a new campaign with specified arguments.

methods.name: deleteCampaign
methods.description: Deletes an existing campaign identified by provided arguments.

methods.name: describeCampaign
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific campaign.

methods.name: getCampaignState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a campaign.

methods.name: updateCampaignName
methods.description: Updates the name of a campaign.

methods.name: updateCampaignSchedule
methods.description: Updates the schedule for a campaign.
